blocks.text: Phishing ek online scam (dhoka) hai jis mein attackers (hamla karne wale) aap ko dhoka de kar sensitive (nijji aur qeemti) maloomat nikalwana chahte hain, jaise passwords, credit card numbers ya bank details.

Misal: Aap ko aisi email aa sakti hai jo aap ke bank ki lagti hai aur link par click kar ke account details likhne ko kehti hai. Phishing pehchanne ka matlab hai aisi emails ko jaali samajhna, aur na kisi link par click karna na koi maloomat dena.

blocks.prompt: Online khatre pehchanne aur cybersecurity ke khatron se bachne ke do tareeqe bataiye. (Short question 8)
blocks.explanation: 1) Phishing pehchanein: jo email ya message password ya account details maange, use jaali samjhein; link par click na karein aur bhejne wale ki tasdeeq karein (maslan bank se khud us ke official number par rabta karein). 2) Malware se bachein: software sirf bharose wali jagah se download karein aur antivirus software update rakhein, ta ke nuqsan deh file pakri jaye.

items: Phishing pehchanna: password, card ya bank details maangne wali emails jaali samjhein; link na kholein, maloomat na dein.
